subtopics.title: Data Quality
subtopics.summary: The criterion ensuring training data is accurate, reliable, and free from errors, analogous to using fresh ingredients in cooking, which directly impacts model performance.

subtopics.title: Data Coverage
subtopics.summary: The criterion ensuring the training data includes the right mix of domains and topics, such as general knowledge, math, coding, and multilingual content, without over- or under-representing any area.

subtopics.title: Data Quantity
subtopics.summary: The criterion determining the volume of training data required for a model, balancing the amount of data against training costs and desired capabilities.

subtopics.title: Phase-Specific Data Mixes
subtopics.summary: The variation in optimal data composition across different training phases, such as pre-training, supervised finetuning, and preference finetuning, as demonstrated by domain mix tables.

subtopics.title: Synthetic Data Generation
subtopics.summary: The use of AI-generated data to increase training data quality and quantity, particularly when human-generated data is limited, expensive, or of lower quality for specific tasks like tool use or complex math.
